The '''ice kitten nip''' was a type of purple-blue [[Flower/Legends|flower]] native to the planet of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. They were named after the juvenile [[Pantran whitefang]], who were also known as "ice kittens", who often ate the plants.<ref name="Ice Kitten Nip" />
